export interface Contact { name: string, email: string, message: string }
export type ContactErrors = Partial<Record<keyof Contact, string>>

const emailPattern = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/

export function checkContact({ name, email, message }: Contact): ContactErrors {
  const errors: ContactErrors = {}

  if (name.trim() === '')
    errors.name = 'Name is required.'

  if (email.trim() === '')
    errors.email = 'Email is required.'
  else if (!emailPattern.test(email.trim()))
    errors.email = 'Enter a valid email address.'

  if (message.trim().length < 20)
    errors.message = 'Message must be at least 20 characters.'

  return errors
}
EOF

--- server
import { t } from 'kay'
import { checkContact } from '../contact'
import ContactForm from '../components/contact-form.kay'

export const send = action(t.Object({
  name: t.String({ maxLength: 200 }),
  email: t.String({ maxLength: 320 }),
  message: t.String({ maxLength: 5000 }),
}), (input, ctx) => {
  const errors = checkContact(input)

  if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0)
    return ctx.fail(422, { errors })

  return { name: input.name.trim() }
})

cat > src/components/contact-form.kay <<'EOF'
---
import { ActionError } from 'kay'
import { send } from '../routes/contact.kay'
import { checkContact } from '../contact'
import type { ContactErrors } from '../contact'

const failed = send.failed()
const errors = signal<ContactErrors>(failed?.data?.errors ?? {
  name: failed?.errors?.name,
  email: failed?.errors?.email,
  message: failed?.errors?.message,
})
const thanked = signal(send.succeeded()?.data.name ?? '')

async function submit(event: SubmitEvent) {
  event.preventDefault()
  const form = event.currentTarget as HTMLFormElement
  const fields = new FormData(form)
  const found = checkContact({
    name: String(fields.get('name') ?? ''),
    email: String(fields.get('email') ?? ''),
    message: String(fields.get('message') ?? ''),
  })

  errors.set(found)
  thanked.set('')

  if (Object.keys(found).length > 0)
    return

  try {
    thanked.set((await send(fields, { refresh: false })).name)
    form.reset()
  }
  catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof ActionError))
      throw error
    const data = error.data as { errors?: ContactErrors } | undefined
    errors.set(data?.errors ?? { name: error.errors.name, email: error.errors.email, message: error.errors.message })
  }
}
---
if thanked
  p(role="status") Thanks, {thanked}! Your message has been sent.
form(action={send} novalidate onSubmit={submit})
  .field
    label(for="name") Name
    input#name(type="text" name="name")
    if errors.name
      p.error {errors.name}
  .field
    label(for="email") Email
    input#email(type="email" name="email")
    if errors.email
      p.error {errors.email}
  .field
    label(for="message") Message
    textarea#message(name="message")
    if errors.message
      p.error {errors.message}
  button(type="submit") Send
EOF
